title: Lachesis M9 Operational Supplement: Trusted Controlled Host Boundary

This separate append-only record would archive exactly the frozen 45-file M9b.13f.2 operational supplement and its 12-file signed independent-review receipt under the supplement/ and independent-review-receipt/ namespaces. It must remain embargoed and non-public through at least 2030-08-01T00:00:00Z, with no view-only link.
